name: PixelYourSite
couldBuild: Dropping the Meta, GA4 and TikTok tags onto a page and firing purchase events from WooCommerce. The first version works in an evening.
stillMissing: The tags are the easy half. Server-side Conversions API with correct browser/server deduplication, GA4's ecommerce event schema, and consent mode are each a moving target maintained by a company that isn't you — and every ad platform changes theirs on its own schedule. When it silently stops matching, your reporting is wrong and nothing errors.
requirements: Tag output for the platforms you actually run ads on
Ecommerce events (view, add to cart, purchase) with correct payloads
Server-side Conversions API with event deduplication against the browser
Consent mode so tags respect the cookie banner
UTM and click-ID capture surviving across the session

alternatives.name: PixelYourSite (free)
alternatives.desc: Browser-side tags and standard events; server-side and multi-platform are paid.

alternatives.name: Site Kit by Google
alternatives.desc: Free and official if Google properties are all you need to wire up.
